subject: Post-call: Discovery recap + scheduling technical deep dive
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Carter <alex.carter@brightscale.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-03-01T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: Discovery recap + scheduling technical deep dive

Hi Alex —

Thanks for taking the time today — really appreciate the context on BrightScale's latency-sensitive search use case and the challenges you're seeing at peak load. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned: 

- Recap:
  - Current infra: hybrid cloud with on-prem index, spikes during end-of-quarter reporting.
  - Key goals: sub-200ms L1 query latency at 95th, predictable per-token cost, and tighter audit logs for compliance.
  - Constraints: data residency for some PII, procurement timeline in Q2.

- Proposal for next meeting:
  - Technical deep dive / demo where Dev (our SE) can walk you through architecture options, quantization/serving tradeoffs, and a short live demo of a pinned query workload.
  - Duration: 60 minutes.
  - Suggested windows (PT): Tue Mar 2, 10:00–11:00 or Tue Mar 2, 14:00–15:00.

- Ask: Please confirm which time works and who from your side will attend (engineering/contact for SRE and procurement contact for contracting). We’ll send a calendar invite with a Google Meet link once we confirm.

Attached is a draft mutual action plan to help scope next steps and owners — feel free to redline.

Thanks — looking forward to taking this forward.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Office: (415) 555-0123

Attachment: RWI_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.pdf
From: Alex Carter <alex.carter@brightscale.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Narang <priya.narang@brightscale.com>
Date: 2026-03-01T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Discovery recap + scheduling technical deep dive

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap; this looks right. Either time on Tue works for us, but we prefer 14:00–15:00 PT to give the team time to prep. Attendees from BrightScale:
- Alex Carter (Product Lead)
- Priya Narang (SRE lead)
- Vikram Rao (CTO) — may join for first 20–30 min

Please send the calendar invite with the Meet link and let us know if you want us to share a short dataset/example queries beforehand.

—Alex
Alex Carter
Product Lead | BrightScale
alex.carter@brightscale.com
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-03-01T18:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Discovery recap + scheduling technical deep dive

Perfect — I’ll lead the technical deep dive and demo.

Agenda I’ll cover (60 min):
1) 10m: Architecture options and recommended routing/caching for hybrid indexes
2) 20m: Live demo of pinned queries with our runtime (quantization + batching settings)
3) 15m: Q&A on security/data residency and audit logs
4) 15m: Next steps / mutual action plan review

Marissa — once you send the calendar invite I’ll add a short internal prep doc and the sample request payloads to the event notes.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
